name: KeeWeb
tagline: A KeePass vault on this device. Copy a password, never fill another site.
description:
Open a .kdbx, or start a new vault, and keep logins on this computer. Groups, entries, a password generator, and TOTP codes — the same file KeePass and KeeWeb already use, encrypted with Argon2. Unlock with your master password (and an optional key file). Export writes a .kdbx you can open in KeePassXC.

Copy-paste only. There is no browser extension and no autofill into other sites: username, password, URL and OTP copy to the clipboard when you ask, and that is the whole hand-off. Closing the app locks the vault. The master password is never stored.

An unofficial port of KeeWeb by Antelle, MIT-licensed. KeeWeb's Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, WebDAV, plugin gallery and KeePassHTTP autofill are not in this app. connect-src stays closed; there is no network path at all. The engine is kdbxweb (the same library KeeWeb uses) plus a pure-JS Argon2, packed inside this GIF.
